title: Clutch Funding Data Export record
description: Daily export of account funding transactions, including the funding provider and transaction identifiers. Derived from the published Clutch data dictionary at https://support.withclutch.com/support/solutions/articles/153000248795-data-exports-funding

applicant_name.description: String: applicant's first and last name. Null if the user dropped-off before identifying themselves.

member_nr.description: Number: the user's member number in core. Null if the user wasn't an existing member and didn't finish the application.

application_id.description: String: a uuid that represents an unique account opening application.

account_id.description: String: a uuid that represents an unique account.

transaction_funding_date.description: Timestamp: date and time when the account was funded.

account_type.description: String: account type that the user is applying for. Null if the user dropped-off before selecting one.

funding_type.description: String:the funding method the applicant has chosen:CREDIT_CARD: credit card (Stripe);INTERNAL_ACCOUNT: transfer from existing account at the CU;ACH: transfer from existing account in another institution (Plaid);CASH: cash;LFAO: funding performed by the CU via transfer from the GL;NULL: user dropped-off before choosing a funding method.

funding_amnt.description: Number: amount the user decided to use to fund the account.

payment_transaction_id.description: String: identifier used by the provider for the transaction.

branch_name.description: String: the name of the branch where the application is sitting at.
